description: This file contains utility functions and page creation logic for generating challenge and superblock pages in a Gatsby-based React project, including mapping challenge types to templates and handling challenge page context.

methods.name: getTemplateComponent
methods.description: Returns the template component based on challenge type.

methods.name: createChallengePages
methods.description: Creates challenge pages with context, including challenge metadata and project preview.

methods.name: getProjectPreviewConfig
methods.description: Generates project preview configuration for the last challenge in a block.

methods.name: createSuperBlockIntroPages
methods.description: Creates superblock introduction pages with validation for certification in frontmatter.
